svg.text: Video / Audio to SRT Subtitle Converter
Version 2.0.0 - Convert any movie or audio file to subtitles
2. Choose "Single video / audio file" or "Entire folder (batch)"
3. Pick your file/folder - Choose transcription method - Done! SRT files appear beside your video
Takes any video file (MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, etc.) or audio file (MP3, WAV, FLAC, etc.) and
automatically generates .srt subtitle files - ready to use in any media player or editor.
Also produces an English translation (.en.srt) automatically - no API key needed for translation.

Times are approximate for a 76-minute film on RTX 3060 Ti (GPU) / Intel CPU
FFmpeg is not on your PATH. Install from ffmpeg.org and add to system PATH.
Activate venv first, then run: pip install faster-whisper
Audio may be music-only or very low volume. Check the file in a media player.
Billing not enabled on Google Cloud project. Enable in Google Cloud Console.
Service account key may be revoked. Check in IAM - Service Accounts.
Whisper hallucination on music/silence. Fixed via VAD filter (built-in).
Use vdo2srt.bat which handles venv automatically, or activate venv first.
Or check the detailed technical documentation in docs/technical.md
